messages:
maya (PM): Folks, I want to lock scope & launch gates for the structured-output + tool-calling PRD. We have multiple customer asks and limited eng bandwidth. Proposing a clear acceptance harness so we only ship safe defaults.

maya (PM): Draft goals: 1) predictable failure modes, 2) schema validation hooks, 3) clear rollout gates (internal -> pilot -> GA). Need owners and a checklist.

dave (Eng): +1. For scope: do we require strict JSON schema enforcement at runtime or opt-in? Strict will break more customers but is safer.

maya (PM): Prefer strict-by-default for new endpoints, with a compatibility flag for legacy routes. That way new integrations get safety.

sophia (Eng-ML): Validation strategy: 1) schema-first validation for tool-call payloads, 2) a fallback to structured 'error' object if model returns unparsable output. Also recommend a golden prompt set for regressions.

arne (DevEx): Docs/SDK impact: need example wrappers in JS/Python, plus an optional helper that auto-sanitizes and retries. Will add to the DevEx backlog if we can finalize the API shape.

lucas (Customer Success): We have 3 pilot customers asking for: model-provided arguments for external API calls, typed enums for action selection, and clear error codes. They will only trial if rollback is possible within 24h.

maya (PM): Ok — launch gates I propose: A) internal dogfood pass (team + SRE), B) 2 external pilot customers, C) perf & cost SLO check, D) docs + SDK samples, E) QA acceptance harness green.

qa-bot: Acceptance tests (suggested):
- schema_validation: must reject invalid types and return structured error (code: INVALID_SCHEMA)
- tool_call_roundtrip: model->tool args parsed correctly >= 98% on gold set
- partial_output_handling: if missing fields, return ERROR_PARTIAL_OUTPUT + original text
- retry_flow: on transient parse errors, attempt normalizing retry x2

maya (PM): Edge cases we must cover in PRD: malformed JSON in tool args, open enums (new values), unknown tools, nested callbacks, large argument blobs, and streaming boundaries.

dave (Eng): Implementation notes: runtime should expose these error codes: INVALID_SCHEMA, UNKNOWN_TOOL, TOOL_ERROR (3xx/5xx), PARTIAL_OUTPUT. Also include a compact safety header on responses: `x-rw-output-status: OK|ERROR|FALLBACK`.

sophia (Eng-ML): For model-side mitigation: prefer function signatures that are as small as possible. Add a generation-time verifier that rejects tokens outside allowed unicode ranges and flags hallucinated URLs.

arne (DevEx): SDK helpers: `parseToolOutput(response, schema) -> {ok, value, errors}` example:
```js
const {ok, value, errors} = parseToolOutput(res, schema)
if (!ok) { // attach telemetry and show human-friendly fallback }
```

lucas (Customer Success): Also need runbook for customers: how to opt into compatibility mode, and how to request emergency rollback.

maya (PM): Performance & cost gating: target p95 parse+validation latency < 200ms for typical 1-2KB outputs; extra validation paths should be async unless strict mode. Cost: prefer default batching/caching so per-1M token cost doesn't exceed current baseline by >5%.

dave (Eng): Rollout plan: canary 5% with feature flag + synthetic traffic that hits schema edges, monitor error rates & beta customer signals. If INVALID_SCHEMA spikes >1% or 5xxs increase, auto-roll back.

maya (PM): Owners: Engineering -> dave; ML validation suite -> sophia; DevEx samples -> arne; Customer pilot coordination -> lucas; QA harness -> (qa-bot) + eng.

qa-bot: I'll provision the gold prompt set and run nightly runs. Please add any additional edge-case prompts to the `#product` pinned doc.

maya (PM): Next steps: dave, can you post a short RFC with the error codes + runtime headers + compatibility flag by EOD Friday? Also include a small example of fallback payload shape.

dave (Eng): Will do. Quick example fallback payload we plan to use:
```json
{
  "status": "ERROR",
  "error_code": "INVALID_SCHEMA",
  "message": "Expected field 'args.user_id' as integer but got string",
  "raw": "<original model output>"
}
```

sophia (Eng-ML): I'll add generation-time checks and the golden set. Also proposing a small eval: `schema-precision = parsed_matches / attempts` to track regressions.

arne (DevEx): I'll draft the SDK helper API and a one-pager with timeline for docs.

lucas (Customer Success): I'll line up the two pilot customers and confirm rollback SLAs.

maya (PM): Great. If no blockers I'll mark this as the PRD scope baseline and we iterate on the RFC. Thanks all :rocket:
